name: ru.show-stolicy/tickets
title: Show Stolicy
description: Search Moscow performances, check seats and reserve tickets. Payment is on show-stolicy.ru.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search upcoming Moscow events by title, date, type or venue. Accepts natural phrases such as "plays this weekend" or "концерты завтра". Always pass lang with the user's language (en, zh or ru) so titles, venue, hall and address come back in that language. Each event has venue (building), hall, address and place (venue and hall together).

query.description: Title, person, type or a natural phrase, in any of ru, en, zh.

lang.description: Language of the reply: pass the user's language (en for English, zh for Chinese). Default ru. Untranslated names stay in Russian.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get one event by id: title, date and time (Moscow), category, venue, hall, address, description and price range. Pass lang with the user's language.

lang.description: Language of the reply: pass the user's language (en for English, zh for Chinese). Default ru. Untranslated names stay in Russian.

tools.name: get_seats
tools.description: List seats that are currently free for an event, grouped by section, row and price: each group has the section name, row number, seat numbers (e.g. "1–4, 7"), price and the placeIds in the same order as the seat numbers. Use placeIds with get_widget_link or create_order. Pass lang with the user's language for section names.

lang.description: Language of the reply: pass the user's language (en for English, zh for Chinese). Default ru. Untranslated names stay in Russian.

tools.name: get_widget_link
tools.description: Return a show-stolicy.ru embed link with preselected seats and utm_source. No referral code. Pass lang with the user's language: the page opens in English for en and Chinese for zh.

lang.description: Language of the reply: pass the user's language (en for English, zh for Chinese). Default ru. Untranslated names stay in Russian.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create an order with selected seats, name, email, phone, consent and an idempotency key. No email confirmation code. The buyer receives the usual payment email. At most 6 seats, 2 unpaid holds per email, and 5 orders per email per day.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Return status for an order that belongs to the given email.
